topic: UPI MDR from 15 Oct 2026 + no charges on UPI up to Rs 2,000 / RuPay debit (PSS Act s.10A notification S.O. 5067(E))

slides.title: UPI par **charge**? Pehle sach jaaniye
slides.subtitle: Kuch bade merchant payments par fee lagegi — lekin **customer ki jeb se nahi**.
slides.cite: **NPCI FAQ** (15 Sept 2026) · Finance Ministry notification **S.O. 5067(E)** (14 Sept 2026)

slides.label: Kya badla
slides.title: Rs 2,000 tak UPI **bilkul free**
bullets: Finance Ministry ki notification: **Rs 2,000 tak ke UPI payment** aur **RuPay debit card** payment par koi bank ya system provider charge nahi le sakta.
Rok **direct aur indirect**, dono tarah ke charge par hai — paisa bhejne wale aur paane wale, dono ke liye.
Yeh power Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007 ke naye **Section 10A** se aati hai.

slides.label: 15 October se
slides.title: Bade merchant payments par **MDR**
bullets: NPCI FAQ ke mutabiq, **Rs 2,000 se upar** ke chuninda merchant (P2M) UPI payments par **0.4% MDR** lagega, max **Rs 300**.
Railways, telecom, insurance, fuel jaisi categories mein flat **Rs 5**. Mutual funds aur securities par sirf **0.02%**.
Example: Rs 3,000 ke payment par merchant **Rs 12** dega. Rs 2,000 tak ke payment par **zero**.

slides.label: Aapke liye matlab
slides.title: Customer se **ek paisa extra nahi**
bullets: MDR **merchant** bharega. Woh ise customer par **pass nahi kar sakta** — aap sirf likhi hui keemat denge.
Dost ya family ko paisa bhejna (**P2P**) har amount par free. UPI apps koi **platform fee** nahi le sakti.
Jis chhote merchant ke QR par mahine mein **Rs 1 lakh tak** aata hai, us par zero MDR. Purana QR badalna nahi padega.
slides.note: Kanoon ka fact: MDR **sarkari tax nahi** hai. NPCI ke mutabiq yeh paisa UPI system, cybersecurity aur fraud rokne par lagega.

slides.label: Dhyan rahe
slides.title: Afwaahon se **bachein**
bullets: "Ab har UPI payment par charge" — yeh **galat** hai. Fee sirf kuch bade merchant payments par hai, aur woh bhi merchant deta hai.
Sahi jaankari ke liye sirf **Finance Ministry, RBI, NPCI aur PIB** ke official updates dekhein.
Yeh post sirf jaankari ke liye hai, legal advice nahi.

slides.title: Kanoon samjho, **haq** jaano
lines: Har din ek nayi legal update, aasaan bhasha mein.
**Save** karein, aur jise zaroorat ho usse **share** karein.

caption:
UPI par ab charge lagega? 🤔 Sach yeh hai 👇

15 October 2026 se NPCI ka naya MDR framework lagu ho raha hai. Rs 2,000 se upar ke kuch merchant (P2M) UPI payments par 0.4% fee lagegi — maximum Rs 300. Railways, telecom, insurance, fuel jaisi categories mein flat Rs 5.

Lekin yeh fee merchant bharega, aap nahi. Merchant ise customer par daal nahi sakta. Dost/family ko paisa bhejna (P2P) har amount par free hai, aur UPI apps koi platform fee nahi le sakti.

📌 Kanoon kya kehta hai: Finance Ministry ne 14 Sept 2026 ki notification S.O. 5067(E) se Rs 2,000 tak ke UPI payment aur RuPay debit card payment par bank/system provider ke har direct ya indirect charge par rok laga di hai — Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007 ke Section 10A ke tahat.

Source: NPCI FAQ (15 Sept 2026) · MoF notification S.O. 5067(E) (14 Sept 2026)
